description: The signed atomic diagram and the quantifier-free diagram of \(M\) have exactly the same \(L(M)\)-models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.models_signed_iff_models_quantifierFree.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [(L.withConstants M).Structure N] :
  N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.signedDiagram L M ↔
    N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.quantifierFreeDiagram L M
